profile.headline: Software Engineer • Full Stack Developer
profile.bio: Full Stack developer focused on software engineering with solid experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Go, React.js and Next.js. Native Android mobile development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, plus Flutter. Building scalable back-ends with RESTful, gRPC and MQTT APIs integrated with NoSQL and SQL databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Redis, MySQL and SQL Server). Experience with Docker, Docker Compose, CI/CD pipeline automation and version control with Git/GitHub. Strong focus on Artificial Intelligence: prompt engineering and use of AI agents (OpenClaw, OpenFang, Hermes Agent) and LLMs such as ChatGPT, Opus, Grok, GLM and DeepSeek, plus TensorFlow.js and Three.js.

items.company: Multiple clients (collaboration with Microsoft professional – USA)
items.summary: Full stack development of a complete platform: back-end in Go (Fiber, GORM, Asynq/Redis, JWT) with RESTful, gRPC and WebSocket APIs; front-end in Next.js 15, React 19 and TypeScript; and a native Android mobile app in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, multi-module Clean Architecture and MVVM, real-time communication via gRPC/MQTT. Infrastructure on Docker and Docker Compose with PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Redis and Nginx. Also projects involving financial analysis with ChatGPT and TensorFlow.js and 3D visualizations with Three.js.
highlights: Native Android mobile with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Clean Architecture (MVVM)
Back-end in Go and Node.js with RESTful, gRPC and MQTT APIs integrated with the front-end
Infra with Docker/Docker Compose, MongoDB, PostgreSQL/PostGIS and Redis; CI/CD automation
Advanced AI usage: prompt engineering and agents (OpenClaw, OpenFang, Hermes) and LLMs (ChatGPT, Opus, Grok, DeepSeek)

items.summary: Development and maintenance of ERP and ordering system (MySQL, PHP, React.js and Node.js), monitoring rollout (Grafana, Zabbix) and team leadership for technological innovation and digital security.
Website development and infrastructure management with Windows Server, Zabbix, Grafana and GLPI; network and systems support, including firewalls and server maintenance.
